items.title: CryptokiMan Blog
items.content_html: Read CryptokiMan news and articles about the PKCS #11 management utility.

items.title: Linux Install
items.content_html: Install CryptokiMan on Linux from the ZIP package, extract the files, and start the PKCS #11 management tool from a terminal.

items.title: MacOS Install
items.content_html: Find the current status of macOS download and installation instructions for CryptokiMan and links to general setup guidance.

items.title: Windows Install
items.content_html: Install CryptokiMan on Windows using the setup wizard, choose an installation folder, and launch the PKCS #11 management tool.

items.title: Licnese Features
items.content_html: Compare CryptokiMan features available with and without a valid license, including PKCS #11 sessions, object management, and cryptographic operations.

items.title: Getting Started
items.content_html: Get started with CryptokiMan: load a PKCS #11 module, inspect tokens, open a session, log in, and manage objects.

items.title: CAVP
items.content_html: CryptokiMan: Runs supported CAVP and ACVP test workflows using the selected Cryptoki slot, including Monte Carlo, request/response, and algorithm-specific tests.

items.title: Close Session
items.content_html: CryptokiMan: Closes the selected session, or closes all sessions for the selected token.

items.title: Copy Object
items.content_html: CryptokiMan: Creates a copy of a selected token object. Review the source object, then set the attributes for the new copy.

items.title: Create Data
items.content_html: CryptokiMan: Creates a PKCS #11 data object on the selected token with application data and object attributes.

items.title: Create DSA Private Key
items.content_html: CryptokiMan: Creates a DSA private-key object with key material, identifying information, and private-key usage attributes.

items.title: Create DSA Public Key
items.content_html: CryptokiMan: Creates a DSA public-key object with public-key material, domain parameters, and public-key usage attributes.

items.title: Create ECDSA Private Key
items.content_html: CryptokiMan: Creates an elliptic-curve private-key object, including curve parameters and private-key usage attributes.

items.title: Create ECDSA Public Key
items.content_html: CryptokiMan: Creates an elliptic-curve public-key object with curve and point information and public-key usage attributes.

items.title: Create Key
items.content_html: CryptokiMan: Creates a key object from selected key information and object attributes.

items.title: Create PQC Private Key
items.content_html: CryptokiMan: Creates a post-quantum cryptography private-key object for a supported algorithm and parameter set.

items.title: Create PQC Public Key
items.content_html: CryptokiMan: Creates a post-quantum cryptography public-key object for a supported algorithm and parameter set.

items.title: Create RSA Private Key
items.content_html: CryptokiMan: Creates an RSA private-key object from its key components and private-key attributes.

items.title: Create RSA Public Key
items.content_html: CryptokiMan: Creates an RSA public-key object from its modulus and public exponent, with configurable attributes.

items.title: Decrypt
items.content_html: CryptokiMan: Decrypts input data with a selected key and mechanism. It supports operation parameters, direct input or source files, and output to a destination file.
